body.name: Restricted QMD reduced-experiment transfer handle
body.construction: Restrict the product laws to the dominated QMD family \(\{\mathbb P_{n,\eta}:\eta\in\mathcal K\}\), use the common parameter map \(\psi_n(\eta)=((\sqrt n\,s_{j,n})_{j\in\mathcal J},(b_{j,n})_{j\in\mathcal J},\Omega_n)\), and compare only the reduced experiment \(\mathcal E_n^{\mathrm{mean}}\) with its Gaussian counterpart. Construct two-sided Markov kernels by QMD/LAN likelihood-ratio approximation and Nussbaum-style smoothing after proving \(\sup_{\eta\in\mathcal K}\|\psi_n(\eta)-\eta\|\to0\). Treat tail control separately by requiring uniform integrability of the candidate diameter losses, for example through a uniform moment bound of order strictly greater than one.
